bug_semantics: The Admin Console gadget endpoint passes the request-controlled #{param.gadget} value to gf.getGadgetModule, which accepts a path or complete URL and parses the referenced XML. JSFTemplating then resolves handler input in a context where a resulting #{...} string is evaluated again, while gadget.jsf emits pageSession.gadget.text with escaping disabled. Attacker-controlled gadget XML can therefore inject server-side EL; the unrestricted resolver exposed class/getClass, constructors, static methods, and static fields, making the injection capable of remote code execution.
flaw_origin: Commit ece6ab82e495d2cf87cbf4ec78170727adf2c7f1 is the smallest BIC: it added gadget.jsf and completed the request-reachable path from #{param.gadget} to the pre-existing URL-capable gadget loader and doubly evaluated template content. Commit 16e12748c3def5754a21f3019a1794b899862017 added the loader infrastructure shortly before, but did not expose the gadget.jsf request endpoint. Eclipse root commit 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb is only the later aggregate Initial Contribution carrying the already-vulnerable flow.
ai_marker: absent — git cat-file -p on the BIC commit object names Ken Paulsen <kenpaulsen@java.net> as author and committer on 2009-07-02; its message contains SVN revision and Former-commit-id provenance but no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI-tool trailer, or bot identity.

Thus the primary correctly records the audited repository's landing merge as fix_sha and its atomic member as direct_fix_sha; the reviewer incorrectly shifted fix_sha to the member and direct_fix_sha to an upstream dependency-repository patch.

git diff cafaeae1b29b0552ca283e62004c047ea7082b34^ cafaeae1b29b0552ca283e62004c047ea7082b34 -- appserver/pom.xml shows the complete audited-repository remediation delta: jsftemplating.version changes from 4.1.0 to 4.2.0 and nothing else in that file. git show --stat confirms both the direct member and landing merge concern this one dependency bump. The upstream c0eff55a82a96eeea9933104ae5003e9220dfb93 object is not an object in the audited GlassFish repository, so it is supporting source-fix evidence rather than this case's direct_fix_sha.

The bundle advisory declares org.glassfish.main.admingui:admingui 8.0.2 and org.glassfish.jsftemplating:jsftemplating 4.2.0 as first patched. git rev-parse resolves tags 8.0.1 and 8.0.2 to ff828fde4a080f2c2a867d7149b853a26749baed and 5225f2e584d7eff969cd39ca26aa67e5dd828736. git merge-base --is-ancestor returns false for both the landing merge and direct member against 8.0.1 and true against 8.0.2. Reading appserver/pom.xml at those tags shows 4.1.0 in 8.0.1 and 4.2.0 in 8.0.2, directly verifying the advisory boundary.

git diff-tree --name-status -r ece6ab82e495d2cf87cbf4ec78170727adf2c7f1 reports five added gadget/dashboard files, including gadget.jsf as A rather than a rename or move. Its patch adds gf.getGadgetModule("#{param.gadget}", ...) and h:outputText escape="false" beside the warning that JSFT content is evaluated twice. git cat-file -e on 5c957a61e840840475827b6954bcf05fb93d81e2:v3/admingui/common/src/main/resources/gadgets/gadget.jsf fails because the path is absent, directly proving the immediate-parent boundary.

Commit 16e12748c3def5754a21f3019a1794b899862017 adds GadgetHandlers.getGadgetModule, accepting a complete URL or path and parsing it with ConfigParser; ancestry places it before the BIC, with unrelated 5c957a61e840840475827b6954bcf05fb93d81e2 between them. git cat-file -p 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb shows a parentless Initial Contribution, and its gadget.jsf blob already contains the same request-controlled call and double-evaluation warning. That root import is therefore rejected as an aggregate origin.

The reviewer identified the correct atomic dependency-bump member but placed it in fix_sha and then placed a patch from the separate jsftemplating repository in direct_fix_sha. In this audited GlassFish repository, 90090d7234f6e1c4df3c92903d150371353efbc2 is the mainline landing merge and cafaeae1b29b0552ca283e62004c047ea7082b34 is its direct causal member; the parent/member graph and the one-line version delta establish that relationship, while the 8.0.1/8.0.2 tag checks establish that this landing closes the declared package boundary. The BIC commit object has no AI signal, so the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI.
